sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption reviewed police complaints legislation and public administration complaint pathways at the Attorney-General’s request.
sentences.support:
By letter dated 30 October 2014 you requested that I undertake a review of the legislative 
schemes governing

sentences.text: The review considered complaint oversight, assessment, investigation and whether intake processes could be consolidated.
sentences.support:
with a particular focus on whether or not the complaint/report processes 
to those offices can be consolidated in one office.

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that overlapping responsibilities and slow resolution made the existing integrity system cumbersome.
sentences.support:
There are too many 
agencies and those agencies overlap in their respective responsibilities.

sentences.text: The Commissioner made 29 recommendations, including replacing police complaints legislation, abolishing the Police Ombudsman and giving the Office for Public Integrity oversight of police complaint handling.
sentences.support:
New police complaints legislation should invest the role of overseeing the 
management of complaints and reports about police in the OPI.

findings.quote: Complaints and reports about public administration are taking too long to resolve.
